title: Wind Chimes and Phoenix
description: A surreal painting featuring a row of metallic wind chimes hanging from a blue-grey fence. In the upper portion, two glowing white birds fly amid swirling light, while a swirling red and yellow phoenix-like form rises from the bottom right corner.
prompt: Surreal painting of metallic wind chimes with colorful striations hanging from a blue-grey fence, set against a bright swirling sky of pale yellow and white. Two luminous white birds fly above with trailing ribbons of light. In the bottom right, a swirling vortex of red, orange and yellow forms a rising phoenix shape, with circular motion lines throughout the composition.
